none: PAS SUSS-B25ED1: Roman Nummus of Licinius I
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete Roman nummus of Licinius I (co-emperor with Constantine I from 308-324 AD). Minted in London, c. 313-314 AD. Reece Period 15. The obverse depicts a laureate, probably cuirassed bust facing right; legend probably reads: [IMP LIC]INIVS P[F] [AVG]. The reverse is probably GENIO POP ROM reverse type, depicting Genius with modius standing left, loins draped with himation, patera in right…
